instruction: Two-Storey Duplex Pair This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an Archicad two-storey duplex pair and save the required output to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. 1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes. 2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 12 IfcSpace entities. 5. The IFC model contains at least 5 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, at least 1 IfcRoof entity, and at least 2 IfcStair entities. 6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: A-LIVING, A-KITCHEN, A-BATH, A-STAIR, A-BED-1, A-BED-2, B-LIVING, B-KITCHEN, B-BATH, B-STAIR, B-BED-1, and B-BED-2. 7. A-LIVING, A-KITCHEN, A-BATH, A-STAIR, B-LIVING, B-KITCHEN, B-BATH, and B-STAIR are assigned to one storey, and A-BED-1, A-BED-2, B-BED-1, and B-BED-2 are assigned to the other storey. 8. Each listed space has a Reference property or LongName equal to its zone number: A-LIVING A01, A-KITCHEN A02, A-BATH A03, A-STAIR A04, A-BED-1 A05, A-BED-2 A06, B-LIVING B01, B-KITCHEN B02, B-BATH B03, B-STAIR B04, B-BED-1 B05, and B-BED-2 B06. 9. The IFC area quantities for the spaces are A-LIVING 20.0 m2, A-KITCHEN 7.5 m2, A-BATH 5.0 m2, A-STAIR 4.0 m2, A-BED-1 9.6 m2, A-BED-2 6.4 m2, B-LIVING 20.0 m2, B-KITCHEN 7.5 m2, B-BATH 5.0 m2, B-STAIR 4.0 m2, B-BED-1 9.6 m2, and B-BED-2 6.4 m2, each with tolerance +/-0.10 m2. 10. The total area of all A-unit spaces is between 50.0 m2 and 55.0 m2, and the total area of all B-unit spaces is between 50.0 m2 and 55.0 m2. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
